name: Trinity Technologies Juba Data Center
notes: Xinhua reported South Sudan launched a Trinity Technologies data center in Juba on 2019-05-28, offering colocation for businesses, government and NGOs and described as Tier II with a Tier III roadmap. Trinity's own site says its Juba/Hai Malakal data center supports connectivity services; Inflect lists a Trinity Technologies Juba facility at Norfolk Street, Central Equatoria. Public MW capacity not disclosed; Inflect lists 200 kVA power infrastructure.

name: National / Resilient Data Center
developer: Government of South Sudan / Ministry of Information, Communication Technology and Postal Services; World Bank funding referenced
notes: WeAreTech reported an Oct. 2024 ministry announcement that World Bank funding had been secured for South Sudan's first resilient data center. Eye Radio reported on 2026-04-30 that the ICT minister said a national data center was being built and was halfway complete. Specific site and capacity were not published; classified to Central Equatoria because Juba is the seat of the ministry and the only location evidenced in related digital infrastructure coverage.

name: Digitel Data Center Complex, Juba
developer: Digitel Holdings Ltd. / Digitel South Sudan
notes: Digitel's official event page places its July 12, 2021 mobile-network launch at 'Digitel Data center - Juba South Sudan'; Gulf News reported the MNO launch took place at Digitel Data Center Complex, Juba. Treated as an operational telecom data-center complex rather than a public colocation facility; no capacity disclosed.

name: Boma Cloud & Data Center
developer: Boma Rural Connect / Boma Research Center
notes: Boma Rural Connect's official site advertises 'Boma Cloud & Data Center' as a local cloud platform offering virtual servers, object storage, managed databases, colocation racks and local CDN edge nodes, with current service including Juba. Exact facility address, launch date, and capacity were not disclosed; classified to Central Equatoria because Juba is the cited served location and market anchor.
